entities.name: tert-Butyl ester deprotection
observations: Acidolysis converts a tert-butyl ester, CC(C)(C)O-C(=O)-, to the corresponding carboxylic acid, HO-C(=O)-; the scaffold is otherwise unchanged.
Three matching ORD records report 98.9% yield in acetonitrile over 1 hour with chloride/HCl-related input; temperature was not reported.
The three records are duplicated entries, not independent condition sets.

entities.name: HCl in acetonitrile
observations: Close database-supported condition for tert-butyl ester deprotection: HCl/chloride-related input in acetonitrile, 1 hour, 98.9% yield; temperature not reported.

entities.name: tert-Butyl ester substrate
observations: The input contains a tert-butyl ester that is converted to a carboxylic acid in the product.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: The product contains the deprotected carboxylic acid corresponding to the input tert-butyl ester.
